access.accessHistory: Direct personal access; Shanghai meeting planned.

strategicTrigger.text: Expansion and development of hydrogen mobility and hydrogen technology applications in Europe.

evidence.text: REFIRE has a European office/subsidiary in Stuttgart.
REFIRE describes activities spanning design, testing, prototyping, application engineering and manufacturing at scale.
A 2025 Hy24/REFIRE partnership was announced to accelerate hydrogen ecosystems in Europe and develop a Sino-European supply chain.

investmentHypothesis.text: REFIRE could potentially develop its existing European presence into a broader industrial operating platform as European customer demand, localisation requirements and hydrogen infrastructure develop.

records.investmentQuestion: What would REFIRE need in Europe to move from its existing European presence towards a larger industrial operating platform?
attackSheet: How does REFIRE see the long-term role of Europe?
Which functions should remain in China and which need to be localised in Europe?
What European activities could move beyond sales, service and engineering?
What would trigger European assembly, manufacturing or other industrial capacity?
Which location factors would determine such a decision?
disqualifyingEvidence: European activities remain primarily commercial or technical.
No additional European industrial capacity is required.
Manufacturing and assembly remain fully concentrated in existing Asian facilities.

nextAction.description: Qualify the next industrialisation step for Europe during the Shanghai meeting.

access.accessHistory: Direct access through existing German and European network.

strategicTrigger.text: European EV market entry combined with European R&D and design activity.

evidence.text: Xiaomi established an EV R&D and Design Center in Munich in early 2025.
The Munich team contributed to the development of the Xiaomi YU7 GT.
Xiaomi's European activity currently provides evidence of market entry and R&D, but not a confirmed European vehicle production site.

investmentHypothesis.text: Xiaomi could potentially develop broader European industrial functions beyond market entry and R&D, including localisation, supply-chain or manufacturing activities.

records.investmentQuestion: What role does Xiaomi see for Europe beyond sales, service and R&D?
attackSheet: How does Xiaomi see the evolution of its European industrial footprint?
What is the long-term role of Munich beyond R&D and design?
Is localisation of components or supply chains being considered?
Is European production part of the long-term perspective?
disqualifyingEvidence: European strategy remains limited to sales, service and R&D.
No European manufacturing or localisation strategy is planned.
Industrial decisions for Europe remain entirely outside Europe.

nextAction.description: Use existing German/European access to determine whether Xiaomi has an industrialisation question beyond R&D.

strategicTrigger.text: Current European electrification and electric commercial vehicle activity provides an opportunity to re-qualify the historic electric-truck discussion.

evidence.text: A previous personal discussion in Japan already covered electric truck construction.

investmentHypothesis.text: Nissan may have an evolving European industrial requirement around electric commercial vehicles, but existing production capacity may also be sufficient.

records.investmentQuestion: When we discussed electric trucks in Japan, the subject was already on the table. How has that question evolved within Nissan since then?
attackSheet: What has changed since we discussed electric trucks in Japan?
